title: CSS Shape Generator
description: Generate CSS shapes — triangles, circles, stars, hexagons, diamonds and more — with live preview and copy-ready CSS.
howto: Pick a shape, size and color from the controls.
Watch the live preview update as you change options.
Copy the generated CSS or download it as a .css file.
Paste the .csg-shape rule into your project and add the class to any element.

faqs.a: Triangle (4 directions), circle, oval, square, diamond, pentagon, hexagon, star, cross, arrow, chevron, parallelogram and trapezoid.
Triangles use the classic border trick; all other shapes use clip-path polygons, so they scale cleanly at any size.

faqs.q: Will the CSS work in all browsers?
faqs.a: Border triangles and border-radius shapes work everywhere. clip-path polygons work in all modern browsers; very old browsers ignore them.

faqs.q: Can I change the color later?
faqs.a: Yes — every shape takes its color from a single background or border-color value you can edit freely.
